purpose: Combine the accepted single-injector mapping, variable-composition quasi-1D Euler operator, and Chapter 11 Eq.11.38 non-geometric source vector in one CFL/SSP-RK3 compatibility solver while preserving explicit source and boundary gates.
implemented: stage-local recomputation of density/velocity-dependent wall friction
single-cell fuel mass/momentum/enthalpy injection from the frozen mapping
explicit dimensional wall specific-heat-gain gradient channel
variable-composition CFL controlled SSP-RK3 pseudo-time advancement
scientific_boundaries: The single-injector operating-point composition/source mapping is fixed during pseudo-time; no species transport PDE is introduced.
The geometric p*dA/dx source is supplied only by the quasi-1D Euler operator and is not duplicated in the Eq.11.38 adapter.
Chemical reaction energy is not added through an independent Qdot source.
The empirical Eq.11.26 wall-heat coefficient is not converted to a dimensional wall heat term; callers must provide d(delta q)/dx explicitly.
Rusanov flux and transmissive boundaries remain compatibility choices, not the final teacher numerical/boundary configuration.
Teacher static inlet p/T/u and outlet first-order extrapolation adapter remains pending.
next_step: Implement and verify the teacher-compatible variable-composition boundary adapter: prescribed inlet static p/T/u with air-only inlet composition and first-order/zero-gradient outlet semantics. Keep Rusanov as the compatibility flux until the sourced variable-property Steger-Warming near-sonic smoothing policy is frozen.
